milestone: SeLinOS fault-mediated Linux syscall ABI M6 deterministic time/resource/non-blocking futex

contract.clock_gettime: Only CLOCK_MONOTONIC (1) with the one mapped anonymous test page is accepted; it returns the fixed timespec {1234, 0}.
contract.getrlimit: Only RLIMIT_NOFILE (7) with a fixed offset in the mapped test page is accepted; it returns {64, 64}.
contract.futex_wait: Only a mapped user word, FUTEX_WAIT operation zero, expected value one, and zero timeout/bitset parameters are accepted. It returns -EAGAIN immediately and never blocks.
contract.futex_wake: Only that mapped user word, FUTEX_WAKE operation one, wake count one, and zero extra parameters are accepted. It returns zero and creates no waiter or scheduler state.
contract.reply_encoding: The probe verifies the negative futex result through EAX, matching the observed UnknownSyscall reply return lane.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M6: deterministic clock_gettime/getrlimit and non-blocking futex mismatch/wake mediated.
SeLinOS ABI M5: getuid/getgid/geteuid/getegid/gettid and mapped set_tid_address mediated.
SeLinOS VFS M0 probe: bounded volatile write/read/close lifecycle passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: deterministic clock_gettime rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: deterministic getrlimit rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded futex wait rejected.
SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded futex wake rejected.

not_claimed: real-time, wall-clock, configurable or monotonic clock semantics
general resource limits or ABI-complete rlimit behavior
blocking futex waits, waiter queues, timeouts, PI, requeue, robust lists or scheduler semantics
TLS, ARCH_SET_FS, clone, thread lifecycle, signals or general Linux process ABI
glibc, dynamic linker, dpkg or apt support
